bio: Located in a beautiful spot not far from Salzburg, the attractive Gut Edermann hotel awaits you with tastefully designed guestrooms and a 2 700m2 spa area, as well as appealing dining options including Bauernstube1910 and MundArt2015. Friendly waitstaff serve up the flavoursome seasonal cuisine in a cosy setting. The preference for locally sourced ingredients reflects the restaurant's commitment to sustainability....
